comment: The visual tour's voice-over. Shot windows match CUES in tour.ts (a test keeps them equal). `text` is what a viewer would read; `say` is what the narrator says (numbers and names spelled out). `at` is seconds after the shot begins. Render with `make narration`; every clip must end 0.3 s before its window does.

lines.text: Riemann's 1859 bet: every zero of zeta, each emerald well you see, sits exactly on this gold line.
lines.say: Riemann's eighteen fifty-nine bet: every zero of zeta, each emerald well you see, sits exactly on this gold line.

lines.text: The proof: twenty chapters, each arc feeding the next, up to Main.
lines.say: The proof: twenty chapters, each arc feeding the next, up to Main.

lines.text: Now the proof's own shape: a million declarations as a single wave. It pictures the code, not zeta.
lines.say: Now the proof's own shape: a million declarations as a single wave. It pictures the code, not zeta.

lines.text: Colour is the live proof. Grey is the dead code it never uses.
lines.say: Color is the live proof. Gray is the dead code it never uses.

lines.text: Together, the outlines mark where the two differ most.
lines.say: Together, the outlines mark where the two differ most.

lines.text: The summit, Main.lean. One theorem here, allChi, stands between Main and eighty-five percent of the proof.
lines.say: The summit, Main dot Lean. One theorem here, all-kai, stands between Main and eighty-five percent of the proof.
